newsitem.title: USA: Atlas Air names Wraight new marketing chief.
newsitem.headline: Atlas Air names Wraight new marketing chief.

text.p: Atlas Air said Stan Wraight, a long-time KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV executive, has joined the contract freighter operator as senior vice-president marketing. Wraight joined KLM in 1965 and by 1995 had risen to head of worldwide sales.

Atlas Air provides Boeing 747 contract freighter lift to several major airlines, including British Airways, KLM, Lufthansa Cargo AG, Varig Brazilian and Thai International Airways. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
